```yaml
name: Generate LLM.txt Documentation
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/generate_llm_txt.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/generate_llm_txt.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
  release:
    types: [ published ]

jobs:
  generate-llm-txt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          
      - name: Generate llm.txt
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_llm_txt.py
          
      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add llm.txt
          git commit -m "docs: update llm.txt documentation" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
